mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 325.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 325.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their recent 12-month averages signals robust consumer and business confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 12-month averages, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward 20-day returns as strong employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) is associated with stronger economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS and returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 12-month averages signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are above their 12-month averages, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's restrictive policy reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
